- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1502-1682 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In unified mode, every name that `stage_support_for_phase.sh implement --list` prints goes into `_fetched_scripts` (lines 1502-1505) and is written to the consumer `scripts/.gitignore` (lines 1677-1682). This includes optional helpers and `codex_model_catalog.json`, even when they were never staged.
  WHY: `implement_commit_changes.sh:357-362,380-384` turns each entry into a `:!scripts/<name>` exclusion and a `git reset HEAD` target. So if the support ref is missing an optional helper, a consumer-owned file with the same name is silently left out of the PR. Legacy staging only listed names it had actually fetched. Severity disagreement: openai and glm rated it MAJOR; sonnet and minimax rated it NIT (sonnet says it is unreachable today because all ten optional scripts exist; confidence 2); gemini gave no severity. The highest rating is used.
- scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:165-172 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `files_touched_scope_guard.py` is in both `stage_support_required_scripts` (line 165) and `stage_support_optional_scripts` (line 172), so `implement --list` prints it twice.
  WHY: The duplicate gives a second `_fetched_scripts` entry, a second `scripts/.gitignore` line and a redundant second install (implement.yml:1878-1882). Nothing breaks, but it breaks the one-entry-per-name `--list` contract. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:165-280 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Because `files_touched_scope_guard.py` is required in unified mode, staging exits 1 at lines 276-280 ("Missing required support script") when a support commit has the `implement` case but not this helper.
  WHY: The legacy workflow treats this helper as fail-open (implement.yml:1555-1573), so the unified path reverses a documented degradation contract during ref-skew rollouts and blocks implementation. Severity disagreement: glm rated it MAJOR (confidence 3); openai rated it NIT (confidence 4). The highest rating is used.

  WHY: None of these map to the diff statically. Either the attribution is noise or there is an undiagnosed breakage outside the changed files. The suites and ruff need re-running on the PR head, and the byte size of implement.yml needs confirming (about +71 net lines; the size-limit test is in the inherited failure list). glm rated it MAJOR.
- tests/test_setup_serena_toml.py:N/A (test suite) | severity=high | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The suite expects support scripts in the checkout directory, but P2b now stages them to `RUNNER_TEMP`.
  WHY: The tests cannot find the scripts, which blocks CI. Gemini gave no severity for this entry; the rating is taken from gemini's related TASK_GAP (MAJOR). Sonnet's verification notes reject the claim: the suite uses the repo's own scripts/ and setup_serena.sh is unchanged.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:N/A (test suite) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  WHY: The tests fail and block PR validation. Gemini gave no severity for this entry; the rating is taken from gemini's related TASK_GAP (MAJOR). Sonnet's verification notes reject the claim: the suite uses the repo's own scripts/ and .claude files, which the PR does not change.
- changelog.d/stuck-states-p2b-implement-support-scripts.md, agents.d/stuck-states-p2b-implement-support-scripts.md:N/A (filenames) | severity=low | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: Neither fragment filename has the `<issue-or-pr>-` prefix the naming convention calls for (expected `8736-stuck-states-p2b-implement-support-scripts.md`).
  WHY: The fragments still fold, but the convention drifts, tooling that keys on the number will not match them, and per-PR path uniqueness is lost. minimax and openai rated it NIT; gemini gave no severity. glm considered it and dropped it (precedent of unprefixed `stuck-states-*` fragments). Sonnet did not raise it (the plan grant names these exact paths).

- scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:implement case, line 165 (required) and line 172 (optional); --list branch line 193 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `implement --list` prints files_touched_scope_guard.py twice. It goes into _fetched_scripts twice (implement.yml:1502-1504), is written twice to scripts/.gitignore (implement.yml:1681) and is installed twice (implement.yml:1878-1882).
  WHY: Nothing breaks, but it breaks the one-entry-per-name --list contract, and the optional entry is never used. Fix: remove the name from stage_support_optional_scripts (1 line).
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:lines 1502-1505 and 1677-1682 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Unified mode adds every optional name to _fetched_scripts and scripts/.gitignore even when stage_support_for_phase.sh skipped it (lines 286-292). Legacy added a name only after installing it (lines 1566-1572, 1643-1649). The commit step excludes and resets these names (implement.yml:4435-4440, 4464-4468).
  WHY: It cannot trigger today because all ten optional scripts exist in any ref that has the implement case. It becomes reachable only if one is later removed. Sonnet downgraded the pass-1 MAJOR rating. Fix: add only names for which "${support_run_src}/<name>" exists (about 3 lines).

  WHY: Copilot review is unavailable for this PR and the PR cannot fix it. It is listed only because unmapped failed check-runs must be reported.

  PROBLEM: The exemption matches on exact line text, so an identical bare call anywhere else in implement.yml is also exempted and a real regression would pass.
  WHY: Fix: exempt by the start/end line indexes of the exempt step (about 6 lines).
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:implement case, stage_support_optional_scripts (line 172)
  PROBLEM: Duplicate files_touched_scope_guard.py.
  WHY: Remove it from the optional array (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
